# Bohrium

> Bohrium is an AI-powered research platform enabling global scientists to discover, analyze, and collaborate on scientific knowledge across disciplines.

Bohrium leverages advanced AI technologies including DeepThink and R1 to provide intelligent search, cross-disciplinary research discovery, and lab integration capabilities. The platform serves as a comprehensive research database and collaboration hub for scientists worldwide, supporting academic research in mathematics, biology, medicine, and other scientific fields.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered search
- Scientific discovery
- Academic research
- Cross-disciplinary collaboration
- Research database
- Lab integration
- DeepThink
- Science Navigator
- Mathematical analysis
- Fractional differential equations
- Nanobodies
- Cardiac research
- Scholar collaboration
- Uni-Lab

## Platform Overview

- [Bohrium | AI for Science with Global Scientists](https://www.bohrium.com/en/intro): Bohrium platform overview: AI for Science with DP Technology's integrated research suite
